def: The Chinese lab DeepSeek's family of open-weight models, notably the V-series mixture-of-experts models and the R1 reasoning model (January 2025), released with detailed technical reports.
practice: R1 ships under the MIT License, which permits commercial use and distillation, and its reinforcement-learning recipe shaped many later open reasoning models; later releases such as V4.1 Flash are also MIT-licensed.
